name: WC Ticket Manager – Easily Sell Tickets for Events, Concerts, Functions, Fundraisers, or Conferences from your Site
author: PluginEver

sections.description:
Ultimate Solution for Selling Tickets for Your Next Events directly from your WooCommerce Site

WC Ticket Manager is the most powerful WooCommerce extension created for WooCommerce store owners. Sell tickets for events, concerts, functions, fundraisers, or conferences without leaving the WooCommerce dashboard.

WooCommerce is the best eCommerce platform out there but lacks key features for selling tickets. WC Ticket Manager plugin bridges this gap by seamlessly integrating all the necessary functionalities. Transform your WooCommerce store into a complete ticketing platform by incorporating ticket management, and secured and authorized distribution.

👨‍💻 This Plugin is Ideal for:

  • Event Organizers & Venue Owners
  • Promoters and Marketers
  • Artists and Performers
  • Charitable Non-Profit Organizations
  • Sports Organizations
  • Educational Institutions
  • Business Owners
  • And anyone looking to sell tickets for their events.

💵 With WC Ticket Manager You Can Sell:

  • Concerts and Music Festivals: Sell tickets for live music performances, ranging from small local gigs to large-scale music festivals.
  • Theater Performances: Manage ticket sales for plays, musicals, and other theatrical productions.
  • Conferences and Seminars: Ideal for business and educational events, including industry-specific conferences, academic seminars, and networking events.
  • Workshops and Classes: Sell tickets for educational and skill-building workshops, cooking classes, art sessions, and more.
  • Sports Events: Suitable for ticketing for local sports matches, tournaments, and sporting events.
  • Exhibitions and Art Shows: Manage entries for art exhibitions, museum tours, and cultural events.
  • Charity Events and Fundraisers: Organize ticket sales for charity galas, fundraising dinners, and community events.
  • Fairs and Festivals: Handle ticketing for local fairs, seasonal festivals, and public gatherings.
  • Online Webinars and Virtual Events: Sell tickets for online events, including webinars, virtual conferences, and live-streamed performances.
  • Private Parties and Social Gatherings: Useful for managing private event tickets like exclusive parties, networking meet-ups, or social club events.
  • Corporate Events and Business Functions: Ideal for ticketing for corporate events, business functions, and professional networking events.
  • Educational Events and Training Sessions: Manage ticket sales for educational events, training sessions, and workshops.
  • Community Events and Public Gatherings: Suitable for ticketing for community events, public gatherings, and local celebrations.
  • Seasonal Events and Holiday Celebrations: Organize ticket sales for seasonal events, holiday celebrations, and special occasions.
  • Art and Craft Shows: Manage ticket sales for art and craft shows, artisan markets, and creative exhibitions.
  • Film Screenings and Movie Nights: Sell tickets for film screenings, movie nights, and cinema events.
  • Food and Drink Festivals: Ideal for ticketing for food and drink festivals, culinary events, and tasting sessions.
  • Health and Wellness Events: Suitable for ticketing for health and wellness events, fitness classes, and wellness retreats.
  • Tech and Innovation Conferences: Manage ticket sales for tech and innovation conferences, industry-specific events, and product launches.
  • Fashion Shows and Runway Events: Organize ticket sales for fashion shows, runway events, and designer showcases.
  • Gaming Tournaments and Esports Events: Sell tickets for gaming tournaments, esports events, and competitive gaming matches.
  • Travel and Adventure Events: Ideal for ticketing for travel and adventure events, outdoor activities, and adventure sports.
  • Weddings and Celebrations: Manage ticket sales for weddings, celebrations, and special occasions.
  • Art and Music Workshops: Suitable for ticketing for art and music workshops, creative classes, and skill-building sessions.
  • Book Readings and Literary Events: Organize ticket sales for book readings, literary events, and author talks.
  • Dance Performances and Choreography Shows: Sell tickets for dance performances, choreography shows, and dance competitions.
  • Comedy Shows and Stand-Up Performances: Ideal for ticketing for comedy shows, stand-up performances, and comedy events.
  • Science and Technology Events: Manage ticket sales for science and technology events, educational workshops, and innovation showcases.
  • Cultural Festivals and Heritage Events: Suitable for ticketing for cultural festivals, heritage events, and traditional celebrations.
  • Artisan Markets and Craft Fairs: Organize ticket sales for artisan markets, craft fairs, and handmade goods exhibitions.
  • Music Lessons and Instrument Workshops: Sell tickets for music lessons, instrument workshops, and music education events.
  • Fitness Classes and Wellness Retreats: Ideal for ticketing for fitness classes, wellness retreats, and health and wellness events.
  • Professional Development Workshops: Manage ticket sales for professional development workshops, training sessions, and skill-building events.
  • Industry-Specific Conferences: Suitable for ticketing for industry-specific conferences, trade shows, and professional networking events.
  • Product Launches and Brand Events: Organize ticket sales for product launches, brand events, and promotional activities.
  • Art and Design Exhibitions: Sell tickets for art and design exhibitions, creative showcases, and design events.
  • **And many more.

💻 Live Demo Site | 📄 Plugin Documentation

✨ How You can benefit from using WC Ticket Manager for your businesses:

  • Streamlined Ticket Sales: Simplify the process of selling tickets online, integrating seamlessly with your WooCommerce store.

  • Easy Management of Events: Create, manage, and track multiple events. This includes setting ticket prices, limits on ticket quantities, managing ticket availability, and more.

  • Automated Processes: WC Ticket Manager automates various aspects of the ticket-selling process, such as issuing tickets, sending confirmation emails, and managing attendee lists.
    This reduces the workload and minimizes the chance of human error.

  • Customization Options: Customize ticket formats, pricing, and sales strategies to tailor the ticketing process to suit your specific event or business needs.

  • Enhanced Customer Data Insights: You gain valuable insights into your customer’s buying behaviors and preferences, which can help in tailoring future marketing and event strategies.

  • Integrated Payment Solutions: Being part of the WordPress ecosystem, WC Ticket Manager supports various payment gateways, providing customers with flexible and secure payment options that are available for WooCommerce.

  • Scalability: Whether you’re hosting a small workshop or a large concert, WC Ticket Manager can scale to meet your needs, handling anything from a handful to thousands of ticket sales.

  • Cost-Effective: No need to use third-party ticketing services, WC Ticket Manager can be more cost-effective, especially as it reduces the need for additional transaction fees per ticket sold.

  • Real-Time Reporting and Analytics: Access to real-time sales data and analytics helps in making informed decisions about your event, such as understanding peak sales periods, and demographic information about your buyers, etc.

  • Marketing Integrations: Integration with marketing tools and plugins (like email marketing services) allows for more effective promotion and follow-up with attendees.
    Customer Support and Engagement: The plugin can facilitate better customer support and engagement through automated reminders, updates about the event, and post-event follow-ups.

✨ WC Ticket Manager Features:

  • Easy Ticket Creation: Create tickets for various types of events directly from your WordPress dashboard. You can set different ticket types, prices, and quantities.

  • Customizable Ticket Templates: Customize the information, ticket number suffix, prefix, and length to match your preferences.

  • Product-Specific Customizations: Set specific information, ticket number suffix, prefix, and length to override the global rule.

  • Automated Email Confirmations: Send automated email confirmations with tickets attached, ensuring attendees receive their tickets immediately after purchase.

  • Custom Tickets Email: Customize the email template to match your branding and provide additional information to attendees.

  • Custom Fields: Add custom fields to the ticket form to collect additional information from attendees, such as dietary restrictions or special requests.

  • Attendee Management: Manage attendee lists, check-in attendees at the event, and track attendance directly through the plugin.

  • Scalability: Suitable for both small events and large-scale gatherings, offering scalability to grow with your event needs.

  • Multiple Payment Gateways: Access to various payment gateways offered by WooCommerce, providing flexibility and security in payment processing.

  • Discounts and Coupon Codes: Implement discounts or promotional codes to encourage sales or reward specific groups of customers.

  • Exportable Data: Export sales and attendee data for further analysis or use in other applications. – PRO

  • Mobile Compatibility: The plugin and its ticket-scanning functionalities are optimized for mobile devices, which is essential for modern ticketing solutions.

  • Real-Time Reporting: Access real-time sales data, attendee lists, and other important metrics to inform your event planning and marketing strategies.

  • Customer Support: Get access to our dedicated support team for any questions or issues you may have while using the plugin.

  • Regular Updates: We are constantly improving our plugin and releasing updates to ensure it remains compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce.

⚡ More Upcoming Features:

We are constantly improving our plugin and bringing new enhancements for your connivance. We’re currently working on some exclusive features and will release them periodically.
Have a look at what’s in our pipeline.

  • QR Code Generation: Each ticket can include a unique QR code for easy check-in at the event, enhancing security and efficiency.

  • Ticket Scanning App: A dedicated mobile app for scanning tickets at the event, allowing for quick and easy check-in of attendees.

  • Ticket Templates: Create custom ticket templates with your branding, logos, and colors to match your event theme.

  • Event-Specific Customizations: Set specific dates, times, design, information, ticket number suffix, prefix, and minimum ticket number length and details for each event, allowing for detailed event management.

  • Analytics and Reporting: Gain insights into sales patterns, attendee demographics, and other important metrics to inform future event planning and marketing strategies.

  • Real-Time Sales Tracking: Monitor ticket sales in real-time, helping you keep track of how your event is performing and manage capacity effectively.

  • Social Media Integration: Share event details and ticket sales on social media platforms directly from the plugin, increasing visibility and engagement.

  • Validation and Security Features: Implement additional security measures to prevent ticket fraud and ensure that only authorized attendees can access the event.

  • Page/Post Content Restriction: Restrict access to specific pages or posts based on ticket purchase, allowing you to create exclusive content for ticket holders.

sections.installation:
Minimum requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater is required (PHP 8.0 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater, OR MariaDB version 10.1 or greater, is required

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WC Ticket Manager, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click “Add New”.

In the search field type “WC Ticket Manager” and click Search Plugins. Once you have found the plugin you can view details about it such as plugin version, rating, and description. Most importantly, of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wc-ticket-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

Updating

Automatic updates should work like a charm; as always though, ensure you backup your site just in case.
sections.faq:
How to create a ticket?

To create a ticket, go to the WooCommerce product page and check/enable the “Sell Tickets” option. You can set the ticket price, quantity, and other details. Once you save the product and publish it, the ticket will be available for sale. Tickets can be created for various types of events, such as concerts, conferences, workshops, and more depending on the ticket settings.

How to customize the ticket template?

You can customize the ticket template by going to the plugin settings and selecting the “General Ticket Options” tab. Here you can set the ticket number suffix, prefix, and length, as well as other ticket details. You can also customize the email template that is sent to attendees when they purchase a ticket.

How to manage attendees and check-in at the event?

You can manage attendees and check-in at the event by going to the “Ticket Manager” admin menu. Here you can view the list of attendees, check-in attendees, and track attendance. You can also export sales and attendee data for further analysis or use in other applications.

How to set up discounts and coupon codes for tickets?

You can set up discounts and coupon codes for tickets by going to the WooCommerce marketing and selecting the “Coupons” tab. Here you can create new coupons, set the discount type, amount, and other details. You can then apply the coupon code to the ticket product to offer discounts to customers.

How to export Tickets data?

You can export tickets data by going to the “Ticket Manager” admin menu and selecting the “Tools” sub-menu and then the “Export” tab. Here you can select the data you want to export, such as sales data, attendee lists, and other important metrics. You can then export the data in CSV format for further analysis or use in other applications.

How to get support for the plugin?

You can get support for the plugin by visiting the PluginEver Support page. Here you can submit a support ticket, ask questions, and get help with any issues you may have while using the plugin.
